mapper.select: SELECT d.business_id FROM digital_team_coordinator_dispatch d WHERE d.status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND d.available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (d.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR d.lease_expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM digital_team_coordinator_dispatch older WHERE older.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND older.project_id = d.project_id AND older.conversation_id = d.conversation_id AND older.status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND (older.created_at < d.created_at OR (older.created_at = d.created_at AND older.id < d.id))) ORDER BY d.created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE digital_team_coordinator_dispatch SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{dispatchId} AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
UPDATE digital_team_coordinator_dispatch SET lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{dispatchId} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT d.business_id AS dispatch_id, d.tenant_id, d.project_id, d.conversation_id, d.message_id, m.user_id, m.message_text, m.attachment_refs, c.session_id AS business_session_id, c.coordinator_session_id FROM digital_team_coordinator_dispatch d JOIN digital_team_project_message m ON m.business_id = d.message_id JOIN digital_team_project_conversation c ON c.business_id = d.conversation_id WHERE d.business_id = #{dispatchId}
SELECT business_id FROM digital_team_coordinator_dispatch WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE digital_team_coordinator_dispatch SET lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{dispatchId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO digital_team_coordinator_dispatch (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, conversation_id, message_id, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{conversationId}, #{messageId}, 'PENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE digital_team_coordinator_dispatch SET status = #{status}, last_error = #{error}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND message_id = (SELECT message_id FROM digital_team_coordinator_plan WHERE business_id = #{planId})
